evidence: Changes the core consensus currency definition in src/consensus/amount.h from an int64_t typedef into a class.
rationale: Improves compile-time safety by preventing uninitialized amounts, implicit boolean/float conversions, and invalid dimensional arithmetic in consensus currency handling (PR description). The author notes it prevents historical bugs such as 0026b330c4 and 890a09b1e4, but because it fixes no active consensus bug and represents internal type hardening, it remains worthwhile but deferrable.
